selectionProfile.description: Strict next-batch selector for PDFs most likely to pass after automated remediation, favoring short non-scanned documents with low-complexity blocker profiles.
exclusionRules: Exclude publications already covered by seeded passing replacements or prior remediation outcomes.
Exclude any PDF with manual-only failure modes.
Exclude PDFs with more than 6 blocker families or more than 12 blocking findings.
Exclude compiler/newsletter-style PDFs due to observed timeout risk.
